LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliMurmur.label: The Dead Speak
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliMurmur.letterText: The warmth of the dead has not yet faded, and a whisper not of this world has already followed bone and memory into your colony. It feels neither like mourning nor prayer, but more like a message carried for someone tangled too deeply with life and death.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliReturn.label: Return of the Dead
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliReturn.letterText: The silence you bought with herbal medicine, or the hostility you ended by your own hands, has settled overnight into the same answer. Zhaoli will come here once more. This time, she will stay.
